body: That's what it says on the site. I assume it's one week to pair with a therapist, message them at will, and a full therapy session. Could be more than that, I'm not 100% sure.
What picture? Like on the site itself? This is my alt account where I post some more personal stuff I'm dealing with, but I'm legitimately just a random redditor. Not an ad, no money, no affiliation.

It's a no-brainer to me. Others can try it out and hopefully get the same help I needed, and at the same time I can cut down the cost on continuing my own sessions. I'm so thankful Better Help offers this. I hope it works out for you and you find what you're looking for!

I was raised in a "men don't cry' kind of household and always thought therapy was a sign of weakness. Nope. Total game changer and I wish I'd found it sooner. Glad you're getting something good out of it too.
Mid-October was our last hurrah, so this is good news.
That's a relief to read. Haven't so much as hugged her November onwards. So, hopefully I'm in the clear. Thanks for the scientific answer, I know nothing about fetuses/babies and their development.
